mode.title: Mode
mode.description: jobs = the newest remote jobs, straight from the feed. search = the same feed narrowed by title, company, category, seniority, location, salary or currency. companies = one record per company with how many roles it is advertising, built from the same pages. reference = check the source is live and report what it returns.
enumTitles: companies - who is hiring, and how much
reference - is the source live, how many jobs

titleContains.title: Job title contains (search mode)
titleContains.description: Keep jobs whose title contains any of these words. Case-insensitive, e.g. 'engineer', 'designer'.

companyContains.title: Company name contains (search mode)
companyContains.description: Keep jobs from companies whose name contains any of these words.

descriptionContains.title: Description contains (search mode)
descriptionContains.description: Keep jobs whose description mentions any of these words - useful for skills and tools, e.g. 'Kubernetes', 'Figma'.

categories.title: Categories (search mode)
categories.description: Keep jobs tagged with any of these detailed categories, e.g. 'Machine-Learning'. Use the exact tags you see in the output.

parentCategories.title: Broad categories (search mode)
parentCategories.description: Keep jobs in any of these broad families, e.g. 'Developer', 'Data Science', 'Sales', 'Design'.

seniority.title: Seniority (search mode)
seniority.description: Keep jobs at any of these levels, e.g. 'Entry-level', 'Mid-level', 'Senior', 'Lead'.

locationRestrictions.title: Location restrictions (search mode)
locationRestrictions.description: Keep jobs restricted to any of these places, e.g. 'United States', 'Germany'. Jobs with no restriction listed are open worldwide and will NOT match a place filter.

employmentType.title: Employment type (search mode)
employmentType.description: Keep jobs of these types, e.g. 'Full Time', 'Contractor', 'Part Time'.

salaryPeriod.title: Pay period (search mode)
salaryPeriod.description: Keep jobs paid on these periods: 'annual', 'hourly', 'monthly' or 'weekly'.

currency.title: Currency (search mode)
currency.description: Keep jobs quoting salary in these currencies, e.g. 'USD'. Worth setting whenever you filter by salary: the feed carries USD, INR, EUR, CAD, PLN and PHP, and salary numbers are never converted between them.

minSalary.title: Minimum salary per year (search mode)
minSalary.description: Keep jobs paying at least this much a year. Hourly, weekly and monthly rates are converted to a yearly equivalent first, so an hourly role is not judged against a yearly number. Jobs that publish no salary are excluded. The figure is NOT converted between currencies - pair this with the currency filter.

maxSalary.title: Maximum salary per year (search mode)
maxSalary.description: Keep jobs paying no more than this a year, on the same yearly-equivalent basis.

salariedOnly.title: Only jobs that publish a salary (search mode)
salariedOnly.description: About half the feed publishes no salary at all. Turn this on to drop those.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum records per run - jobs, or companies in companies mode.

maxScannedJobs.title: Max jobs to scan
maxScannedJobs.description: Your budget for how deep to go into the feed. Filtering happens after fetching, and the source hands out 20 jobs per request, so a narrow filter over 100,000 jobs could otherwise run for thousands of requests. The run stops here and tells you how far it got, so raise this when a narrow search comes back short.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: The source is a public feed and needs no proxy - it answered every request without one. Leave this off unless your own network requires it.
